item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description:
Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 18% vs. market 19% | On paper the Rams have the edge, led by pressure rate: they rank 2nd at 20%, while Arizona's defense ranks 32nd with 20% generated. Arizona's best counter is its run defense, ranked 3rd against the run compared with 29th against the pass.
Matthew Stafford ranks 15th of 31 in EPA per dropback, but the data has no Arizona quarterback, so no comparison is possible. The x-factor is Puka Nacua, who takes 31% of the Rams' targets and 32% of their air yards, with a 0.81 WOPR ranked 2nd of 108, and he meets an Arizona pass defense ranked 29th.
The model makes the Rams the favorite at 82% win probability, with the rushing matchup worth 5.2 points and the passing matchup 4.6 points toward them, while the market implies 81%.
